entries.name: samuelgursky/davinci-resolve-mcp
entries.summary: Updates Node and Python dependency manifests and removes unused uuid dependency. Provider reports remaining transitive advisories.
changes: Aligns the root and advanced Node dependency manifests with updated MCP SDK, XML, ZIP, image, schema, YAML and PostgreSQL libraries.
Removes the unused uuid dependency; retains better-sqlite3 11.x.
Raises the Python MCP SDK minimum to 1.30 while retaining the below-2 cap; raises pyaaf2 to 1.7.1.
Provider reports unchanged Resolve behavior and five remaining transitive Node dependency advisories.

entries.name: Fusion Studio
entries.summary: Adds Krokodove shapes/3D, OpenPBR, DJI D-Gamut2/D-Log2, GoPro Log, Leica L-Log and Vivo transforms.
changes: Adds Krokodove shapes/3D, OpenPBR, DJI D-Gamut2/D-Log2, GoPro Log, Leica L-Log and Vivo transforms.
Improves MultiText alignment and font previews; adds viewer-line lens calibration, OGraf animation controls and multi-template DRFX macro editing.
Adds external camera-track imports, reference-frame tools, deep-image previews, hard-mix blending, HTJ2K EXR input/output and DNG correction bypass.
Supports OCIO 2.5 and ACES 2.0, richer variable syntax, log-conversion alpha handling, matte objects and motion blur in deep Renderer3D, faster deep rendering and monitoring.
Drops Python 2. Mac now requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15. Includes stability improvements; see full notes for exact hardware and driver requirements.

entries.name: DaVinci Resolve / Studio
entries.summary: Media: editable pool fields, recursive/exact searches, geometry previews, timecode and marker batch edits, multicam dates and audio-track controls.
changes: Media: editable pool fields, recursive/exact searches, geometry previews, timecode and marker batch edits, multicam dates and audio-track controls.
Photo: panel-driven RAW settings, sharpening and sidebar improvements, DNG lens corrections, sky replacement and live-view shortcuts.
Editing: inspector presets, expanded multicam controls, timeline comparison, richer markers, waveform display, trim and gap operations, adjustment-clip transitions, backup and playback refinements.
Fusion: Krokodove shapes/3D, OpenPBR materials, MultiText and OGraf controls, DRFX macro editing, tracking import, blend/alpha improvements and metadata variables.
Color: LUT/DCTL relinking, missing-DCTL overlays, additional camera transforms, panel controls and effect scaling.
General: newer hardware/media decoding, HTJ2K EXR output, caption exports, media-management reporting, archive options and PostgreSQL 18 Project Server.
Compatibility: Python/advanced scripting now needs Studio; projects opened in 21.1 cannot reopen in 20.3.2. Apple Silicon and macOS 15 are required on Mac.

Studio additionally brings native MCP/AI integration, expanded Python APIs, MultiMaster trims, deep rendering improvements, extra RAW formats and effects. Read the separate full edition notes for every change and requirement.

entries.name: DaVinci Resolve / Studio
entries.summary: Exact patch identified; proxy relinking, X-OCN formats and timeline scripting updates.
changes: Proxy relinking now accepts mismatched formats.
Imported DRTs reconnect to matching nested clips already present.
Color-page filtering keeps the selected clip visible.
Older Affinity formats can be imported.
Sony FX-5 footage encoded as X-OCN is supported.
Scripts can retrieve the selected timeline clips.
Scripts can obtain a timeline object through its Media Pool entry.
Render-setting scripts gain controls for handles, extents and burn-ins.
Cached large timelines receive real-time playback fixes.
Media Pool Power Bin navigation is corrected.
Media management handles segment-clip suffixes correctly.
Edit Index sorting is corrected.
Pasting timecode no longer triggers the reported source-viewer audio problem.
Several speed-curve retiming problems are corrected.
Windows Fusion templates handle long paths correctly.
Burn-ins regain the missing marker-notes tag.
Decoding is corrected for affected DPX files.
Decoding is corrected for affected CR2 images.
Free-edition notes additionally report a Windows software H.264 decoding fix.
Additional reliability and speed improvements.

entries.name: Fusion Studio
entries.summary: Exact patch identified; Windows long-path support and stability improvements.
changes: Windows handling of exceptionally long paths is corrected.
The Paint inspector’s settings tab receives a fix.
Additional reliability and speed improvements.

entries.name: auto-editor
entries.summary: Audio tone and overlay generators; source-stream handling and decoder fixes.
changes: Adds MIDI-pitched tone generation with sine, saw, square and triangle waves.
Imports all source streams through add, including audio-only sources.
Supports drawbox as a separate overlay generator.
Skips undecodable audio streams and identifies missing codecs in errors.
Updates bundled x265 to 4.3 and libvpx to 1.17.0.

entries.name: DaVinci Resolve MCP
entries.summary: Broader safe-mode coverage and consistent destructive-action classifications.
changes: Classifies all 108 registered destructive actions and expands safe-mode blocking to 35 high or critical actions.
Recognizes source-clip deletion and external camera-sidecar modification risks.
Separates assessed medium-risk actions from unrated operations.
Isolates saved user preferences in tests and adds guards for complete risk classification and consistent inspection/gating.
